context: A teacher walks a teen through research
purpose: Teach: 断面/壁面/踊ら/西暦/果たさ/救命/抵触/徴兵

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、論文、本気で、絶対、時代の断面、絶対、丁寧に、扱っていましたね、本気で、立派
lines.en: Sakura, your paper—the way you handled the historical moment, the cross-section of that era, was really thorough. Genuinely impressive work.
lines.style: Warm and measured, with steady respect. Leans slightly forward on the compliment. Genuine interest lighting the voice, not performative praise. Clear and composed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。お寺の壁面、本気で、絶対、貴重な、絶対、絵画、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、絶対、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I focused on the temple wall paintings—how precious those images were, and what the paper let me explore about them. I really appreciate your guidance.
lines.style: Modest but genuine. A slight breath before responding, showing she's taken the compliment seriously. Warm gratitude, sincere without overdoing it. Steady eye contact in her voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、人々、絶対、政府に、絶対、踊らされた、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心、絶対。
lines.en: And the way you examined how people were led by the government during wartime—you showed real perspective there. Your research was broad and careful. That takes real thought.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational. Slower pace. She's not just complimenting the work; she's genuinely noticing the thinking behind it. Warmth beneath the professional tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。西暦と元号、本気で、絶対、対比、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、本気、本気で、絶対、感謝、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I compared the Western calendar system with the Japanese era names throughout—it really helped me see the deeper layers of the research. I'm truly grateful for your support with this.
lines.style: Sincere and focused. A slight formality in gratitude, but not stiff. She's engaging with what the teacher actually said, not just offering rote thanks. Earnest throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史的役割を、本気で、絶対、果たさず、絶対、終わった、絶対、人物、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you discussed those historical figures who didn't fulfill their roles, who the moment passed by—that showed maturity in your thinking.
lines.style: Engaged and thoughtful. Slower, more deliberate pacing. She's offering substantive observation, not just praise. Genuine intellectual respect in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、救命艇、絶対、活動、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、本気、本気で、絶対、感謝、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Thank you. I examined the wartime rescue operations—the actual work people were doing—and tried to understand it historically. That research meant a lot to me.
lines.style: Humble and direct. She's not over-elaborating; she's confirming what she did with genuine care. Warm but grounded. The gratitude is real, not performed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、法に抵触、絶対、する報道、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And your treatment of the wartime press restrictions, how you explored the legal boundaries of reporting then—that shows real historical understanding.
lines.style: Approving and steady. She's moved past simple praise into recognition of scholarly depth. Clear, measured, with real respect beneath the professional surface.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、徴兵制度の歴史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I worked through the history of conscription during that period carefully. It was important to understand that context. Thank you for everything.
lines.style: Warm closing note. Quieter than previous responses—she's summing up, reflecting. Genuine gratitude without heaviness. A small, sincere exhale at the end.
